name: embedded-assets
body: Only the core of the tool is embedded via Go `embed` and served from the binary: reveal.js (pinned to release 6.0.2, MIT), the core page shells (deck page, full-page error page, /templates gallery page), the minimal `kalide init` seed (see cli-init-minimal-seed), and the static, text-only `AGENTS.md` scaffold guide files (agent-authoring). These are core to the tool, not templates or assets. reveal.js is vendored by copying the release package's `dist/` directory into `internal/assets/reveal/`, committed there as-is together with its `LICENSE` and used directly. Templates, themes, fonts, logos, starter decks and other media live in the project's own template library — either a local `templates/` or a configured external path (see project-templates, external-template-library; global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets). AC: `internal/assets` contains reveal.js and the page shells; `internal/scaffold` contains the init seed and the `AGENTS.md` guide files; templates/, fonts/, logo/, starter/ and theme.css live in project libraries; the core page shells style only via the project theme's stylesheet.
